title: reconcile_scale_ladder_gate.py refuses a genuinely user-held gate
symptom: ValueError: gate is not proven held by the user, raised at reconcile_scale_ladder_gate.py:225, while scontrol show job 250838 reports JobState=PENDING Reason=JobHeldUser Priority=0
root_cause: Not root-caused. The proof-of-held predicate disagrees with the live scontrol record for job 250838. Deliberately NOT investigated: decision D0001 abandons this code path rather than debugging it.

title: launch_scale_ladder.py treated a zero return code from scontrol release as proof of release
symptom: Probes and activation reported released while squeue still showed JobHeldUser; a manual identity-checked release was required
root_cause: scontrol release exit code does not imply the observed post-state; no scheduler postcondition was re-observed

title: Unicorn DefMemPerCPU=1000 silently caps a 2-CPU CG task at 2 GB
symptom: Not yet observed as a failure because no CG task has run under ladder-lite; flagged pre-emptively
root_cause: Slurm config: DefMemPerCPU=1000 with SelectType=select/cons_tres and SelectTypeParameters=CR_CORE_MEMORY, so memory is enforced and an omitted --mem yields threads x 1 GB
evidence_path: submit.sh must pass --mem explicitly: 16G for scale<=13, 24G for scale>=20 and MIP; escalate to 64G on OOM

title: SOC flooring discarded residual energy in the grid state while extracted charging schedules retained it, allowing battery overfill
symptom: Replayed continuous charging schedules could exceed battery capacity
root_cause: Grid DP floors SOC when mapping to lattice state; the old extractor reported the full grid charging gain while continuous replay kept the discarded residual

title: Heuristic label-search DP structurally failed to find long complementary routes
symptom: Known GIRO duties with strongly negative reduced cost at reconstructed duals were never generated by the heuristic pricer
root_cause: Shallow-label queue ordering; equal-cost dominance discarding trip-incidence history needed later; long duties buried behind tens of thousands of labels

title: 22/22 selected known GIRO partitions are continuously feasible but 0/22 fit the primary 15 kWh / 10 min expanded route space; only 9/40 k40 duties fit
symptom: Literal GIRO partitions cannot be rediscovered on the primary grid; duty 13411 fails on all five tested grids down to 1 kWh / 5 min
root_cause: Route-space discretisation, not a graph or duty-identity defect. Post-hoc oracle left all five causal labels unresolved.

title: Producer-hash validator compares tracked artifacts against the CURRENT source file, so any edit to a producer invalidates every past artifact
symptom: Two full-suite failures after a 36-line additive change to src/summarize_scale_ladder.py; the code change itself is correct
root_cause: Design defect: artifacts record a producer hash, but the validator re-hashes the live file instead of comparing against the hash recorded at production time. Consequence: the normalizer can never be improved without either falsifying existing artifacts or regenerating validated diagnostic evidence.
evidence_path: Workaround: keep summarize_scale_ladder.py byte-identical and put ladder-lite mode in src/summarize_scale_ladder_lite.py. Real fix deferred: compare against the recorded historical hash.

title: run_cell.sh single wait() misreports a checkpoint signal as cell failure
symptom: With sbatch --signal=B:USR1@180, the USR1 trap fires, forward() signals the child, and the single wait returns 128+10=138 while the child is still checkpointing. The script writes OUT.failed and exits, killing a healthy run 180s before walltime and marking every walltime-limited CG cell as failed.
root_cause: Missing the reviewed worker's re-wait loop (submit_scale_ladder.sub: while true; wait child; if kill -0 child then continue; break). A trapped signal makes wait return early.

title: run_cell.sh does not sanitise the inherited Python environment
symptom: submit.sh uses --export=ALL, so the login shell (conda '(base)' active on unicorn-login-01) propagates PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME/LD_LIBRARY_PATH to all 138 tasks. A leaked PYTHONHOME breaks the interpreter outright; a leaked PYTHONPATH silently imports foreign packages on heterogeneous compute nodes.
root_cause: The reviewed worker did: unset PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME LD_LIBRARY_PATH; export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. Ladder-lite dropped this along with the eleven provenance guards, but this one is load-bearing for correctness, not provenance.

title: LL_BUDGET_OVERRIDE_S initially retained the normal 60-second CG allocation cushion
symptom: A requested 180-second local smoke would pass --wall-limit-s 240 instead of 180
root_cause: The wrapper applied the plan's budget+60 production rule after replacing the plan budget with the explicit smoke override

title: Correction to B0008: checkpoint signal wait is now resilient
symptom: A trapped USR1 can interrupt wait while the child remains alive
root_cause: The reviewed wait/kill -0/re-wait loop is restored; this row supersedes B0008 without editing it

title: Correction to B0009: inherited Python environment is sanitized
root_cause: run_cell.sh unsets PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONSTARTUP LD_LIBRARY_PATH and sets PYTHONNOUSERSITE/PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE before Python starts; this row supersedes B0009

title: Lite normalizer impersonates execution_mode=local_diagnostic to pass the frozen normalizer's gate
symptom: summarize_scale_ladder_lite.py builds a synthetic plan with filtered['execution_mode']='local_diagnostic' and a manifest with diagnostic_only=False, submitted=False, then calls base.summarize. Any emitted field derived from plan['execution_mode'] therefore labels real Slurm cluster runs as local diagnostics, and 'submitted' is False for runs that were submitted.
root_cause: Chosen route through the byte-frozen normalizer reuses the pre-existing local_diagnostic bypass instead of declaring the true mode. provenance.json is corrected afterwards, but CSV-level labels are not.
evidence_path: Fix: post-pass replacing local_diagnostic with ladder_lite_direct_array in every emitted row and field, plus an assertion that no 'local_diagnostic' string survives in the output dir. Correcting freshly emitted artifacts is legitimate; it is NOT the same as rewriting historical evidence (see D0007).

title: A single stray OUT.override.json hard-fails the entire normalization permanently
symptom: summarize_scale_ladder_lite.py raises 'smoke override cannot be normalized' for any job with an override marker, aborting all 138 cells rather than excluding one.
root_cause: Correct intent (keep budget-overridden smoke rows out of results) implemented as a global abort, violating the A2 requirement that normalization succeed with any subset present.
evidence_path: Fix: route that cell to omitted with reason 'excluded: budget_overridden' and continue.

title: Lite normalizer relies on mutable module globals plus monkeypatching base._validate_completion
symptom: ALLOW_CENSORED and PLAN are module-level state mutated mid-run; base._validate_completion is swapped and restored around base.summarize
root_cause: Necessary consequence of keeping summarize_scale_ladder.py byte-identical. Contained to a single-process CLI.
evidence_path: Accepted: the alternative was editing the frozen normalizer or duplicating its row builders.

title: run_cell.sh resolved REPO from BASH_SOURCE, which under sbatch is the staged script copy, and the failure was silent
symptom: All 43 tasks of arrays 289799/289800 FAILED exit 2:0 in 2-11s with zero-byte stdout and stderr; outputs directory never created
root_cause: Two compounding causes: (1) Slurm stages the batch script to /var/spool/slurmd/job<id>/slurm_script, so dirname BASH_SOURCE/../.. resolved REPO to /var/spool; (2) line 72 'OBSERVED=$(git -C $REPO rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null) || return 2' suppressed stderr and returned bare, making the failure invisible.
evidence_path: Hotfix: hardcode REPO=/home/nc437/ladder-lite/repo, drop 2>/dev/null, add a [ll] host/task/repo banner. Local-only commit; Cursor owes the canonical LL_REPO-export version plus a staged-copy test.

title: plan.sh writes the plan to LL_ROOT/campaign regardless of LL_CAMPAIGN, so a second campaign refuses with 'plan or matrix already exists'
symptom: Changing LL_CAMPAIGN produced a new results root but plan.sh still refused, and the stale plan silently stayed bound to the old commit; a submit against it failed every task with 'commit mismatch'
root_cause: LL_CAMPAIGN scopes the results directory only. The plan/matrix path is fixed at LL_ROOT/campaign and guarded by an exclusive-create.
evidence_path: Workaround: mv LL_ROOT/campaign aside before rebuilding. Real fix: put the plan under LL_ROOT/campaign/<LL_CAMPAIGN>/.

title: plan.sh prints the entire plan JSON to stdout, inviting an operator Ctrl-C during instance staging
symptom: Operator interrupted plan.sh inside _stage_scientific_inputs -> _copy_new -> sha256_file, leaving staging partially complete while the plan JSON already existed
root_cause: Verbose stdout on a long-running step with no progress indication.
evidence_path: Workaround: redirect plan.sh output to a log. Real fix: print only the summary; log the plan to a file.
